about: Goes inside a holding of yours or an ally's to heal and fill the ranks, and stays until it has.
calls_back: the ranks are full and the wounded have healed, or it has rested max_days

full: the share of full ranks that counts as full
max_days: the longest it rests, in days

when.poke: {at} is no longer friendly, so {me} did not rest there.
{me} has rested at {at}: {men} men, ranks at {round(ranks * 100)}%.
{me} rested {max_days} days at {at}: {men} men, ranks at {round(ranks * 100)}%.
